title: Lomé University researchers’ open-ended cessation of academic and pedagogical activity
possible_unit_owner: togo_2020-11; whether any work stoppage or gathering continued into January 2021 is unverified
notes: A 21 December report credited to Liberté and an 18 December official-hosted newspaper issue describe a 20 November general assembly/decision to suspend academic and pedagogical activities until claims were met. They are December reports of a November decision, not independent evidence of January continuation. No January assembly, activity stoppage, attendance count, or public gathering has been verified. Retained as an unresolved cross-month lead only; not a January event.
